column4: Building Resilient Open-Source Supply Chains for India
column6: India's open-source ecosystem is maturing fast, but our supply chains are fragile. This talk covers dependency auditing, SBOM adoption, and how Indian orgs can lead the way in securing the software we all depend on.

column4: Why Your CLI Needs a TUI: Rethinking Developer Tooling
column6: Command-line tools don't have to be ugly. This lightning talk demos three open-source TUI libraries and shows how a 200-line wrapper can turn any CLI into a delightful interactive experience.

column4: From Zero to PR: Your First Linux Kernel Contribution
column6: A hands-on workshop walking participants through setting up a kernel dev environment, finding beginner-friendly bugs, writing a patch, and submitting it upstream. Bring your laptop and leave with a real contribution.

column4: The Invisible Architecture: How FOSS Powers India's Digital Public Infrastructure
column6: From Aadhaar to UPI to CoWIN, India's digital public goods run on open-source foundations most people never see. This talk maps the hidden FOSS stack beneath India's most used platforms and asks: what do we owe upstream?

column4: Designing for 22 Languages: Accessibility in Indian Open-Source Projects
column6: Building software for India means building for linguistic diversity. This talk shares patterns and anti-patterns from localising three major FOSS projects into Indian languages, covering RTL edge cases, font rendering, and input methods.

column4: Open Telescopes: Democratising Astronomy with Raspberry Pi and Python
column6: Amateur astronomy meets open hardware. This talk covers building a sub-$200 automated telescope controller using a Raspberry Pi, stepper motors, and a Python stack for star tracking and astrophotography.

column2: Geopolitics and Policy in FOSS Devroom
column4: Digital Sovereignty and Open Source: Lessons from the EU for India
column6: The EU's Cyber Resilience Act and open-source exemptions offer a blueprint India can learn from. This talk analyses policy models and proposes a framework for Indian FOSS policy that protects both innovation and security.

column4: Building Custom Android ROMs for Indian Feature Phones
column6: Feature phones still dominate rural India. This session walks through porting AOSP to low-spec MediaTek chipsets, optimising for 512MB RAM, and building a minimal launcher for first-time smartphone users.

column4: Soldering for Schools: An Open-Source Electronics Kit for Rural Education
column6: Introducing an open-hardware kit designed for Indian government schools: a $12 BOM, KiCad-designed PCB, and curriculum-aligned lesson plans. Over 200 kits deployed across Maharashtra so far.

column2: Compilers, Programming Languages and Systems Devroom
column4: Writing a Garbage Collector in 500 Lines of Rust
column6: Think GCs are magic? This live-coding session builds a mark-and-sweep garbage collector from scratch in Rust, explaining memory layout, root scanning, and why your language runtime works the way it does.

column4: The One-Person Open-Source Maintainer Survival Guide
column6: Burnout is real. This lightning talk shares battle-tested strategies for solo maintainers: setting boundaries, automating triage, saying no to feature requests, and finding co-maintainers before you need them.

column4: How We Migrated a Government Portal from Oracle to PostgreSQL in 90 Days
column6: A war story from the trenches: migrating a state government's citizen services portal from Oracle to PostgreSQL under political deadline pressure. Covering schema translation, data migration, performance tuning, and the human side of change management.
